name: The Hollow Lamp
blurb: A lamp on a ledge above the pool, burning on no fuel you can name. Beside it sits a trader in an oilskin coat, salvage laid out on a blanket. There is no rig, no tunnel and no rope. The prices are high, and the trader seems sure you will pay them.

supplies.text: Coolant, five drums, cold from the pool.
A drill bit, sharpened by hand on a crystal.
Two shaped charges in oiled paper.

pool.text: Passage for someone who has waited down here too long.
